works.body:
こんにちは。いつもTwitterでのりさんの作品を拝見しております。のりさんが描かれるキャラクターの表情や雰囲気が大好きです。
ぜひ、私のオリジナルキャラクターを描いていただきたくリクエストしました。

【詳細】
・20代前半の男性
・黒髪でボリュームのある無造作な髪型。右目が隠れている。
・黒縁のアンダーリムタイプの眼鏡
・肌は色白
・暗めでアンニュイ

服装、構図、表情などはお任せいたします。


こちらキャラクターのイメージになります。

https://drive.google.com/file/d/123SEF3u7dhI_bt1Gcz8WouIL3fiW3ojL/view?usp=drivesdk

どうぞご検討よろしくお願いします！

Hello!！I really like your art and I want to commission you to draw simple black and white painting（黒白絵 ）for them？

The man with black hair is a 26-year-old detective. He is rather stuffy and has no sense of humor. Although he looks ordinary, he may be reliable.
（wears glasses）
https://sta.sh/0kd0hm19b9f

She is a smart, pretty and perfect high school girl with a cheerful personality who is now working as an assistant in a detective office.Because of her perfection and smoothness, she lost her expectation for the future and once jumped down from the rooftop.
The elements you can refer to are: paper crane, dusk and stage play.
https://sta.sh/0kmb6kf799e

They are close, and girls like to tease men!
Thank you so much for considering me! I appreciate it so much!!

Hello! I love your art! I would like to request an illustration of my original character, Soleil.  He is moody and usually frowning. He is secretly shy. I don't have any specific image in mind, you can draw whatever you like!

Thank you!

https://soleilruan.carrd.co/

連投失礼いたします……
こちらもお手隙があればお願いしたい内容となります。

本件も一次創作の男性2名の一枚絵のリクエストとなります。
ふわっとした感じのブロンドの男性と、ジトッとした感じの黒髪の男性です。双方高山写真家(登山家)で仕事上のパートナー兼同居人です。

こちらも資料URL(box)にキャラクターの資料をご用意したので、参考にしていただければと思います。
※細かい部分はだいたい読み飛ばしていただいて大丈夫です。

ご多忙の場合は私からのご依頼はどちらもご放念ください。
どうぞ宜しくお願いいたします。

https://app.box.com/s/svmoos839oheydlmlftbb3sr18whh3og

いつもTwitterを拝見しています！
のりさんの描かれる温かみのある線と、キャラクターの視線が特に大好きです。

今回、一次創作の男性2名の一枚絵をお願いしたくご連絡しました。
体格のいいぼんやりした登山家の男性と、華奢でおしゃれなバンドマンの男性です。大事な親友同士です。

資料URL(box)にキャラクターの資料をご用意したので、参考にしていただければと思います。
※細かい部分はだいたい読み飛ばしていただいて大丈夫です。

ぜひお手隙があれば制作いただけますと大変嬉しいです！
どうぞ宜しくお願いいたします。

https://app.box.com/s/g598us493gxfiwoqs8tkeemfa9zpcavo

I made a mistake in the price and tried to resend it, but I guess I wasn't able to. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Ms. Nori, thank you so much for the wonderful illustrations you did for us before! I really love the OCs you draw and they are so cute, so please do another one!

I really love your OC illustrations, so I would like to have them again!

Range of depictions: Up to you.

Composition and other images
The woman blushes when the man she loves pats her on the head and stares at her with tearful eyes.
She turns her head and looks at him with tearful eyes.
The face of a man who is smiling.
I couldn't narrow it down to just one, so I would like you to draw all of them like a color rough sketch. If it is too difficult, please use only one of them. Of course, anything other than the above would be fine.
 Also, when you draw the one for "To the man I love," please make sure that the man's hands are so white that they are almost pure white.

Details of appearance, personality, etc.
Refer to the image at the URL.

We have seen the movie that Nori-sensei wrote the script and did the animation for. We really love the world view that only Nori-sensei can create and express. If the price is not suitable, you can cancel the offer. Thank you very much!

https://photos.app.goo.gl/KPHueyXswAtySrKW7

hello. i think your art is so lovely! i would love to request an illustration of my original character. she is very expressive, and not very nice. she loves to gossip, and loves drama. i don't have anything particular in mind, so i will leave it up to you.

https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/46150870_7EFpHvr2p0iPquY.png
https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/46564850_iPlwEumKnqUdbtT.png?1647033316 (she is on the left.)

Mr. Nori
Hello, nice to meet you.
I'm always looking at your wonderful illustrations.
I love your designs so much that I would like you to draw my original character if you don't mind.

Rough details
A 23-year-old office worker.
Her expression changes rapidly.
She's not a tsundere, but has a tsunken attitude.
She is not a tsundere, but rather has a pouting attitude. ・She will go for the guy she likes, but will run away if he comes on to her.
She likes gyaru fashion and leopard print.

For more details on her appearance and clothing, please refer to the URL.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/TsYAQUnPCdFv3P9X6
